place.name: Jarosławiec, West Pomeranian Voivodeship
place.description: Jarosławiec (Polish pronunciation: [jarɔˈswavjɛt͡s]; German: Jershöft) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Postomino, within Sławno County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, in north-western Poland. It lies approximately 13 km (8 mi) north-west of Postomino, 22 km (14 mi) north-west of Sławno, and 180 km (112 mi) north-east of the regional capital Szczecin.
